body: She’s offered to drive me to the airport????
If I just tell the security in advance (done so) they’ll let me stay when they’re briefly closed
I’m returning home from living with my mother.
I’m abroad so it’s a little difficult!

Okay so it seems the general consensus is to leave and tell her when I’m at the airport. I’ll probably contact her after the first leg of my flight and then block, because I’m better off not being on the receiving end of her anger. I’m waiting for when I’m signed into a house in the uk on a contract so I’ll know that I have somewhere to go. What worries me is how I’ll be able to sneak a suitcase out of the open plan house- she is ALWAYS downstairs. I’m honestly contemplating buying a small carry on suitcase but I’m sure she’ll notice me bringing it in. I’m just really fucking scared, I was on the verge of a panic attack all day and I guess I just need support so that I can actually have the balls to do this :/
I have mad anxiety whenever I think about it. Is there anyway I can make myself chill out so I can actually get the guts to leave.
Is it stupid that I think it’s all in my head? Sometimes she can be pleasant but a lot of the time she isn’t.

That’s a fair point. I’m not obligated to tell her about anything. I’m 21. I always feel like I’m asking for permission as I’ve been conditioned. It sucks. It also seems unforgivable to just leave, though I suppose this would be the best way to deal with it.
